_doc: Connected art repos (owner's storage plan, 2026-11-15). A GitHub Pages site may be no larger than 1 GB, so routes' art lives in art-only repos beside wompah1/Catalog, each its own Pages site on the same origin (wompah1.github.io). A route listed under a shard has game/art/<route>/ (and <route>.<set>/) published there instead of in Catalog; its cover.jpg stays in Catalog (the route cards draw every cover). The routes already published when the shards were added (2026-11-15) stay in Catalog. tools/publish.sh runs `tools/shards.py assign`, which gives each route at its first publish the first shard with room (750 MB each) and commits this file; a route never moves once published. A new shard: the owner creates the public repo on wompah1, adds its deploy key (write access), and turns on Pages (Deploy from a branch: main, /) after the first push creates main.
